title: The Apple Watch is on sale for as much as $80 off for Black Friday — here are all the deals worth your time (AAPL)
text:
Tuesday, 20 November 2018 ( 13 hours ago )
· Many major retailers are offering deals on the Apple Watch for Black Friday .
· Stores like Target, Macy's, and Best Buy have all discounted the Apple Watch Series 3, which came out in 2017, by as much as $80.
· So far, there are very few discounts on the new Apple Watch Series 4.
